title: The 3 Best Monitors for Home Office 2026
h1: The 3 Best Monitors for Home Office 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for monitors for home office 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at monitors for home office 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: LG 27GP850-B (27" 1440p)
products.blurb: Key specs: 27-inch IPS, 1440p, 165Hz, 98% DCI-P3, USB-C 90W power delivery.
strengths: 165Hz useful for gaming; 1440p sufficient for document work
USB-C charges laptop through the display connection
Wide color gamut for creative work
Better value than dedicated office monitors at this specification
limitations: USB-C only, no built-in USB hub for peripherals
Stand is adequate but not as full-featured as Dell's ergonomic stand

products.name: ASUS ProArt PA279CV 27" 4K Professional Monitor
limitations: 65W may not fully charge larger laptops
